principles: Sell graded and cleaned produce: grading and packing alone can raise the price by 10-20%.
Join a Farmer Producer Organisation (FPO) or cooperative to aggregate volume, share transport and negotiate better prices.
Store instead of distress-selling: use warehouse receipts / cold storage and sell when prices recover.
Sell direct: farmers' markets, community-supported agriculture, online marketplaces (ONDC in India) and institutional buyers.
